continuity: Jeok Cheongang asked the Azure Sky Sword King to help Jopil escape from the Nangong Family's pursuit.
Jeok Cheongang says he would have saved Jopil again if given the chance, despite regretting the consequences for the following ten years.
Jopil died fighting Jin Taekyung after drawing on his innate qi; half of his upper body was destroyed in the battle.
Jeok Cheongang accepts that Taekyung did what Jeok should have done ten years earlier and acknowledges a debt to him.
Jeok Cheongang sincerely apologized to Taekyung and his companions for his rash actions.
Jeok Cheongang continues to grieve Jangcheon, remembering him as the child and Disciple he once believed he had raised like a son.
Taekyung, Cheongpung, and Hyuk Mujin remain at the inn after Jeok Cheongang dismisses them.
The current day is New Year's Day, and Taekyung realizes that he is away from the Jin Family of Taiyuan despite Wipeng's warning.
plot: Jeok Cheongang reveals that he asked the Azure Sky Sword King to help Jopil escape, considering it the last duty he could perform for his Disciple. He admits that even if he could return to the past, he would save Jopil again, though the following ten years would still be filled with regret.

Jeok learns that Jopil died fighting Jin Taekyung after drawing on his innate qi. He acknowledges that Taekyung did what Jeok should have done ten years earlier, declares that he owes Taekyung a debt, and sincerely apologizes to Taekyung and the others for his earlier rash actions. After dismissing them, Jeok mourns Jangcheon alone and recalls the Disciple's claim that he had never changed.

The next morning, Cheongpung and Hyuk Mujin awaken at the inn. Cheongpung is excited because it is New Year's Day, prompting Taekyung to realize that he is no longer at the Jin Family of Taiyuan and to remember Wipeng's warning from before his departure.

active_continuity: Jeok Cheongang rescued the orphan Jangcheon during an Anhui epidemic and eventually accepted him as his Disciple; Jangcheon later became Jopil.
Jopil rationalized murder through Might Makes Right and became a Slaughter Saint who took pleasure in killing.
Jeok Cheongang secretly followed Jopil for four months, confronted him after witnessing his murders, and could not bring himself to kill him.
Jangcheon took Bone-Melting Powder and declared that he would leave and never return.
Jopil died fighting Jin Taekyung after drawing on his innate qi.
Jeok Cheongang asked the Azure Sky Sword King to help Jopil escape and would have saved Jopil again despite his later regret.
Jeok Cheongang acknowledges that Taekyung did what he should have done ten years earlier and owes Taekyung a debt.
Jeok Cheongang apologized to Taekyung and his companions for his rash actions.
Jeok Cheongang mourns Jangcheon and recalls Jangcheon's claim that he never changed.
Taekyung, Cheongpung, and Hyuk Mujin are staying at an inn rather than the Jin Family of Taiyuan.
The current day is New Year's Day, and Taekyung remembers Wipeng's warning from before he left the Jin Family.
open_questions: What consequences will follow Taekyung's failure to return to the Jin Family of Taiyuan as Wipeng demanded?
